longer.songTitle: Anything You Can Do (feat. Ethel Merman & Bruce Yarnell)
longer.line: [Frank:] Any note you can hold I can hold longer
stanza: [Frank:] Any note you can hold I can hold longer
[Annie:] I can hold any note longer than you
[Annie:] Yes, I can! Yes, I can!
[Frank:] No, you can't -- Yes, you can!
